evidence: New retrospective experiment, declared before examining its results. Not the frozen October 9 experiment.

common_risk.covariance: 252 previous sessions, sample annual covariance, no forward observations
common_risk.selection: Highest shared volatility on two long-only risky-sleeve-plus-cash rays, subject to identical caps and turnover constraints. No leverage.
common_risk.infeasible_rule: Hold both controls and report risk mismatch; never force a match
common_risk.schedule: Existing monthly active dates; fit t-2, execution t-1, return t; existing expiry exit retained

basis.role: Timing-basis diagnostic only, not a substitute for forecast-horizon Omega

forecast_error.policy: Prior-only comparable outcome/lead-horizon gate; deduplicate quarters; retain default below minimum

inference.quarter_score: Separate complete-quarter forecast error from active-view portfolio returns

paper_journal: Hash-chained exclusive entries, current wall-clock capture before execution; separate outcome evaluator; no backdating or broker execution claims
tuning: No post-result parameter selection; correctness repairs must be declared
